info.name: CampusBite — Staff APIs (Anish)
info.description:
Postman collection for all Staff Kitchen & Analytics endpoints.
Branch: feat/anish-staff-dashboard
Author: Anish

Base URL: http://localhost:5000/api

How to use:
1. Set the 'token' collection variable to a valid staff JWT.
2. Run requests in order: Kitchen Queue → Update Status → Toggle Stock → Analytics → Menu.

request.description:
GET /api/staff/kitchen-queue

Returns all active orders with status Placed, Preparing, or Ready.
Sorted by timeSlot then createdAt (oldest first).
Populates: studentId (name, rollNumber), timeSlotId (slotLabel).

Expected: 200 OK — array of order objects.

response.name: 200 OK — Active Orders

request.description:
PATCH /api/staff/orders/:id/status

Moves an order forward in the lifecycle.
Allowed values: Placed | Preparing | Ready | Completed | Cancelled

Now also stamps statusTimestamps.preparingAt on the order document.

Expected: 200 OK with updated order object.
Expected (invalid status): 400 Bad Request.
Expected (order not found): 404 Not Found.

response.name: 400 Bad Request — Invalid Status

request.description: Moves order from Preparing → Ready. Stamps statusTimestamps.readyAt.
Marks order as Completed. Stamps statusTimestamps.completedAt. Removes it from the kitchen queue view.

PATCH /api/staff/menu/:id/toggle

Flips the isAvailable flag on a menu item.
Call once → marks as Unavailable (sold out).
Call again → marks as Available.

Expected: 200 OK with updated menuItem.
Expected (item not found): 404 Not Found.

response.name: 200 OK — Toggled to Unavailable

request.description:
GET /api/staff/analytics

Returns today's canteen performance summary via MongoDB $group aggregation pipeline:
- todayRevenue: total earned in Rs (excludes cancelled orders)
- totalOrders, completedOrders, pendingOrders, cancelledOrders
- topSellingItems: top 5 items by quantity sold ($unwind + $group)

Expected: 200 OK with analytics object.

item.name: 7. Get All Menu Items (Staff Stock View)

request.description:
GET /api/staff/menu

Returns all menu items sorted by category then name.
Used by the Stock Manager tab in StaffDashboard.jsx to display
the full item list with availability toggle buttons.

Expected: 200 OK — array of MenuItem documents.
